# Review: Duplicate Concepts

The procedure does not remove concepts automatically. Removal requires evidence across all five axes below.

| Axis | Question |
| --- | --- |
| State | Do both concepts read and write the same particle/world state? |
| Gate | Do both use the same law bit or runtime condition? |
| Effect | Do both produce the same force, mutation or conservation result? |
| Parameters | Do both consume the same DNA/world/stride parameters? |
| Purpose | Would users perceive them as the same toggle or capability? |

A concept is truly redundant only when all five axes agree and no persistence, UI, audit or compatibility contract depends on the distinction. Representative distinctions are in [sim/concepts.md](../sim/concepts.md).
